reason: Discovery found 3.60 pp oracle lost safe opportunities and 3.68% fixed-selected label changes on IID, versus 0.05% fixed-footprint numerical label sensitivity. This is the one conditional fresh confirmation authorized by Pro.

dataset.appearance: same IID families as E2 training

fixed_assets: All five E2 independent/source64 final checkpoints; restored sigmoid output only for primary predictions; original generator, 512 footprint, 16 representation, tau=.02, public formula, stored uniform tie rule, and one sampled variant/card per scene
selection: No scene rejection based on rendered pixels, costs, margins, oracle feasibility or outcomes; only the existing continuous geometry sampler constraints
sample_integrity: Freeze protocol/code/checkpoint hashes before generating records; audit anonymous shape and complete-scene identity against all E2/E3 records; reject a compromised study rather than replace a scene

H1.prediction: Coarse oracle loses nontrivial safe opportunities even where the fixed-footprint precision check agrees that a safe candidate exists
H1.event: direct512 and property1024/fixed512-footprint each have a safe supplied candidate, but pool512 selection/acceptance fails to yield a direct512-safe accepted action
H1.criterion: one-sided exact binomial lower bound exceeds .01 of all scenes

H2.prediction: At fixed restored-model actions, pooling label changes are predominantly conservative
H2.event: among pool512-vs-reference512 danger-label changes, fraction reference-safe/pool-danger
H2.criterion: crossed model/scene bootstrap one-sided lower bound exceeds .90; undefined denominator is a failure

H3.prediction: Among selected actions with joint property/footprint boundary overlap, small pooled-cost margin enriches pooling label changes
H3.comparison: small-margin flip rate minus larger-margin flip rate, both restricted to joint boundary overlap
H3.criterion: crossed model/scene bootstrap one-sided lower bound exceeds .10; undefined stratum is a failure

uncertainty.scope: H1 exact binomial under IID scenes; H2/H3 approximate crossed bootstrap over only five model seeds and shared scenes. These are mechanism comparisons, not a safety certificate.

secondary: Full same-reference signed decomposition and fixed/reselected decision metrics, including minus2 as explicitly secondary; numeric precision and remaining unsafe model errors retained
numerical_guard: same as discovery; identity residual<=1e-12; reference512 vs property1024 under fixed512 footprint dangerous-label changes<=1% and p95 absolute cost difference<=.002 across all A/C/D candidates. Empirical sensitivity, not exact continuum truth
decision: Support the three-part normal-generator prediction only if numerical guard and all three criteria hold. Report each failure/uncertainty. No sample enlargement, third stage, model change or resolution search.
budget: CPU inference only; no optimization. One 2000-scene bank, <=8 allocated CPU hours. RELLIS remains closed.
